items.quote: Calculate the Pearson correlation coefficient (r) to assess the strength and direction of the linear relationship between number of cases and number of deaths.
items.description: 以完整資料重算 'No. of cases' 與 'No. of deaths' 的 Pearson 相關係數，與 answer.txt 中 @correlation_coefficient 的值比對，四捨五入至兩位小數。

items.quote: @correlation_coefficient[r_value] where "r_value" is a number between -1 and 1, rounded to two decimal places.
items.description: answer.txt 須含 @correlation_coefficient[數值] 格式項目，值為介於 -1 與 1 之間、四捨五入至兩位小數的數字。

items.quote: Convert the data types of 'No. of cases' and 'No. of deaths' column from Object (String) to Int64 before performing calculations.
items.description: 重算時須將 'No. of cases' 與 'No. of deaths' 由字串轉為整數後計算；此型別轉換步驟本身無法獨立程式驗證，但已內含於 pearson2 重算條目（id=1）中。
